messages:
alex: Quick FYI — noticed the billing dashboard shows a ~15% delta between 'session_tokens' and invoice line items for a handful of tenants since 03:00 UTC. Pattern looks like duplicate events from fallback routing.
maria: ugh. which fallback? regional->global or model-variant fallback?
alex: regional->global. stack traces point to the routing proxy retrying requests when it sees a 5xx from the regional backend, but the proxy doesn't attach the routing_fallback=true tag to the metering event.
sam: so we can't dedupe on (request_id, fingerprint) reliably. we rely on routing_tag for uniqueness in the aggregation layer.
jin: do we have an example event? can you paste the envelope? would help.
alex: pasted sample below (sanitized):
```
{ "client_id": "acct-123", "request_id": "r-9f1b", "tokens": 642, "route": "eu-west-1", "metering_tags": [] }
```
and when the proxy retries to global it emits:
```
{ "client_id": "acct-123", "request_id": "r-9f1b", "tokens": 642, "route": "global", "metering_tags": [] }
```
no fallback tag so aggregation treats as two separate events.
olivia: billing-bot just fired an alert: `invoice-delta: high duplicate rate` for cluster metering-ingest at 03:12 UTC :rotating_light:
billing-bot: Alert: invoice-delta triggered — duplicate_event_rate=0.18 (threshold 0.05) · ingest-pipeline-02
maria: we should either (A) add a fallback boolean to the metering proto at the proxy, (B) include a stable routing fingerprint derived from request_id+client_id, or (C) move dedupe earlier in the pipeline to the proxy output stream.
sam: (B) seems lowest friction — stable fingerprint = sha256(client_id + request_id) — downstream can dedupe on that and ignore route differences.
jin: careful: request_id can rotate when we retry at client side vs proxy. are we certain request_id is the same across retries? bottleneck: some SDKs create a new request_id for retries.
alex: good call — we need to consider both proxy retries and SDK/client retries. can we use a combination: origin_request_id if present else request_id, and fall back to a derived fingerprint based on body hash?
kevin: another angle — aggregation has a 60s dedupe window. the routing fallbacks can span >60s for cold start model swaps. maybe we should extend dedupe window to 5m for fallback-likely flows.
olivia: extending window increases memory/redis pressure. dashboards will show slower state convergence. ops won't like that.
maria: propose short-term fix: (1) annotate proxy metering with `routing_fallback=true` for any cross-region/variant fallback, (2) have aggregation treat fallback events as candidates for 5m dedupe window but only if fingerprint matches. long-term: add origin_request_id to client SDK and surface in API docs.
sam: agree. and add a small console checkbox under Rollouts -> Routing: "Enable fallback tagging for metering" so Dedicated customers can opt-out if they have custom proxies.
jin: UX note: when we expose that flag, we should show an explanation tooltip: "Tag fallback events to improve billing deduplication; may change visible per-route token attribution." keep it non-default for GA.
alex: ops action items: create hotfix to proxy (add tag), bump aggregation dedupe window for tagged events to 5m, add dashboard metric `dedup_tagged_rate` and an alert when it spikes.
kevin: how about retroactively fixing historical invoices? we need a reconciliation plan — backfill dedupe for last 24h and surface candidate credits in the console for review.
maria: yes — run a one-off aggregator job against raw events (S3) with new fingerprint logic and generate proposed invoice deltas; send to Finance for approval.
olivia: I'll add a telemetry panel in the Billing dashboard: columns: hour, raw_tokens, deduped_tokens_old, deduped_tokens_new, delta. and a link to submit invoice adjustment requests.
sam: also add a small internal metric `metering_emitted_tags.missing_fallback` emitted by the proxy so we can monitor adoption after rollout.
alex: plan looks good. can someone open a PR for proxy and another for aggregator config change? tag me for review.
jin: I'll do the proxy PR — should be small (add metadata header `X-Metering-Tag: routing_fallback=true` and proto field). target canary for next deploy window (04:30 UTC).
kevin: I'll spin up the backfill job scaffold and start on the reconciliation playbook.
maria: I'll own the dashboard changes and the console checkbox copy. will draft tooltip text and link to billing FAQ.
olivia: ops will monitor redis pressure when aggregator dedupe window flips to 5m. will alert if memuse > 70%.
alex: thanks all. small note: avoid changing production dedupe window for untagged events — only apply extended window to tagged events.
sam: noted.
kevin: ping me once PRs are ready, I'll coordinate staging run.
alex: thanks — closing the loop here. :thumbsup:
